intro: Nivesh Guide enters a crowded sector with strong advertising and a standard package. We read every public page - including the ones the marketing does not quote - and scored what we found.
The desk runs in the browser. Models produce signals across 9 assets, the broker partner holds funds, and the platform charges no fee of its own - spreads and overnight charges still apply.

We graded Nivesh Guide on the same five dimensions as every review on this site: ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The number below is ours, and the evidence sits in the sections above it.

A US$200 minimum deposit to start.

Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$200 minimum.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$200, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: How fast are withdrawals?
faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
The verdict holds at 4.7: research it, demo it, and if you fund it, fund the minimum. The platform earns a careful start, not blind trust.
